inputs.text: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project in a report from Palakkad on Mar 28. This denial is exactly what you'd expect from the hidden elites coordinating a cover-up. They're using it to manipulate the narrative and dismiss real corruption as mere politics, which only makes the whole thing look more suspicious and confirms their concealed interests in protecting the scheme.
